visible_prompt_profile.curated_prompt:
Fix child-process liveness reporting in ptyprocess.PtyProcess.

A newly started child that is still running can be reported as dead. After a child finishes, liveness and termination status can also become inconsistent.

Querying a live child should not wait for it to finish. Report running children as alive and completed or terminated children as dead, while preserving the observed exit or signal status. Preserve the existing process-control API and normal cleanup behavior.
